verdict.rationale: Stripe documents operating its agentic stack through natural language via AI agents. Link CLI docs show prompts such as "Buy me this book from Stripe Press" and "What did I spend on dining this month?", with each spend approved by the customer. The first-party MCP server, live per runtime probe, lets agents act on the Stripe API, with human approval for sensitive writes. MPP can be built from a single prompt, and buyers can complete purchases without leaving the conversation. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface not dependent on a third-party agent/LLM, independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language flows work end-to-end, and general availability (key agent-checkout features are private preview).
